notes:
E-Sys MAX 5.2.2

Fixed
- Code several changes and Save and code no longer stop with "The Coding page could not be read" right after Expert Mode > Coding opens.
- Practice car: the Fake Car download installs again.
- Photos taken upright on a phone now arrive upright in support pictures.
- With two older E-Sys (3.x) installed, starting one no longer says the other is already open.
- E-Sys starts the same way on every PC, even when other Java settings are set on the PC.

Improved
- Sharper support pictures, and photos you send no longer carry camera details.
- Safer saving of FDL editor scripts, job history and the E-Sys settings you put back.
- Updates check more carefully that no other E-Sys MAX window is still starting.
- Problem reports show more about an error, so we can fix it faster.
- Many smaller fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
